note: Annotation-convention classes for source-conditioning tokens. The training pool carries 44 distinct `src` values whose largest is 44% of rows and whose smallest 16 are each under 500 rows, so per-source tokens would be undertrained for the tail. These classes group by annotation pipeline, which is the axis a conditioning token is meant to absorb: rows sharing a class were labelled by the same process under the same convention. `unknown` is reserved for inference and for training-time dropout, and is never assigned by a rule.
